title: Lautaro Martínez has a strain in his left hamstring
description: Gazzetta dello Sport expects five to six weeks out, and Inter play at Bologna on Saturday without their captain.
mast_alt: Nerazzurri Daily Edition No. 45, Friday, October 16, 2026 — Lautaro Martínez has a strain in his left hamstring

blocks.html: Lautaro Martínez, Inter's captain and center forward, has a strain in his left hamstring, the club said on Thursday after tests in Rozzano, outside Milan. Inter gave no return date. Gazzetta dello Sport, Italy's biggest sports daily, expects him out for five to six weeks, and Cristian Chivu, Inter's head coach, faces reporters at 8:30 AM ET, 14:30 CEST, before Saturday's match at Bologna.

blocks.h3: Lautaro Martínez has a strain in his left hamstring
paras: Inter said on Thursday that Lautaro Martínez, the club's captain and center forward, had clinical and diagnostic tests at the Istituto Humanitas hospital in Rozzano, outside Milan. The tests, the club said, "revealed a strain in his left hamstring."
The statement gave no return date. He had played the whole match against Club Brugge two days earlier, and scored twice.

blocks.h3: Chivu speaks at 8:30 AM ET, and the officials are named
paras: Cristian Chivu, Inter's head coach, faces reporters at 8:30 AM ET, 14:30 CEST, at Appiano Gentile, Inter's training ground. This edition went out before he spoke; what he says leads tomorrow.

New since yesterday: Inter's match guide names the full crew for Saturday at the Stadio Dall'Ara. Daniele Doveri referees, with Zingarelli and Bercigli on the lines, Di Marco as fourth official, Gariglio on VAR and Piccinini assisting him. Kickoff is 12:00 PM ET, 18:00 CEST.

blocks.h3: Away tickets at Feyenoord open to loyalty members today
paras: Inter said on Friday that the last sale phase for the away section at Feyenoord opens today at 9:00 AM ET, 15:00 CET. It is open to members of the club's INTERISTA loyalty program, if any tickets are left.
The match is Champions League matchday 4 in Rotterdam, Tuesday, November 3, 3:00 PM ET, 21:00 CET. Tickets are €50, one per member, sold only at trasferte.inter.it, and not transferable.

blocks.h3: Gazzetta dello Sport expects five to six weeks out
paras: Gazzetta dello Sport reported on Friday that the injury is a "lesione" — a muscle tear — at the back of Lautaro Martínez's left thigh. The paper expects a "stop previsto di 5-6 settimane": a layoff of five to six weeks. The club's own word was "strain," and Inter have published no timeline.
On that reading he misses the rest of October and much of November. The report says Chivu expects to see him again after the November international break.
blocks.kicker: GAZZETTA DELLO SPORT VIA FCINTER1908 · OCT 16

blocks.h3: The papers disagree over who starts beside Thuram
paras: Yesterday the press expected rotation at Bologna. Lautaro Martínez's injury has changed the question to replacement.

Gazzetta dello Sport, relayed by FCInter1908, expects Francesco Pio Esposito, a center forward, to start beside Marcus Thuram, Inter's other center forward. Ange-Yoan Bonny waits. Sky Sport Italia's projected lineup puts Bonny there instead. Inter have published no lineup.
